caption: The drawing depicts the interior of a hotel lobby named "Hotel Melrose," as indicated by the gold lettering above the entrance. The scene is dominated by shades of mint green, gold, black, and white. In the foreground, there are several upholstered armchairs with floral patterns in pastel colors, arranged around round tables that have intricate golden bases. One table has a newspaper or menu on it, and another table in the center holds a potted palm plant in a decorative golden vase. The floor is covered with a black and white checkered tile pattern, while green carpets or runners cover certain pathways and stairways. On the left side of the image is a reception area with pigeonholes for keys and a bell, as well as a clock on the wall. A large, ornate black metal elevator cage is present, attended by a carved wooden chair beside it. The walls and supporting columns are adorned with gold accents and decorative details. A wide staircase with green carpeting and ornate railings leads to an upper floor, with a stained-glass window visible at the landing. The space is illuminated by golden chandeliers hanging from the ceiling. There are additional chairs and tables along the right wall, complete with wall-mounted hat racks and letter holders. In the background, an arched opening leads to a corridor floored with the same checkered tile pattern as the lobby.
title: Hotel Melrose Lobby, 1880
